<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032026-09-2903-45-17" status="unreviewed">
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re
  chos gsuM po de dag pa gnyis kyi ngang bzhin yin pa zhes pas slong pa'i ye shes gcod la | 'dus ma byas yin pa zhes pas || sems bam pas rgyu rkyen gyis
          
            <pb n="81"/>
         
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="N001"/>dpang asal pa tsam pa yongs rtag zhag sala zang bdang na ral phrasu yang la yod par dag du 'dod
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="N002"/>| bskyed pa 'dus bas saM mi rtags pa sa de pa gcod la || zag pa med pa'i yen tan dang dbyer med pa zhes pas dbu ma ba kha 'dram cai yod ste pa'i lhag med kyi nas 'das pai ye shes rgyun chad du 'dod pa gcod pa'i zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
